ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.label: chapel
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.description: An altar at the far end, a lectern before it, four pews facing them with an aisle down the middle, and two braziers.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.purpose: A place for the colony's rituals and sermons. A fine ritual room makes every ceremony held in it go better.

tips.li: Ritual quality depends on the room around the altar: impressive rooms make better ceremonies.
Pews facing the speaker let the audience sit and extend the good mood after a speech.
Some memes want ideoligion buildings or a certain style in the ritual room. Check the ideoligion's precepts.
Braziers count as light and decoration. Darklight braziers suit memes that prefer the dark.

ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.label: schoolroom
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.description: Four school desks in two rows with an aisle down the middle, two blackboards, a toy box and good light.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.purpose: Children learn at the desks while an adult teaches. Blackboards in the room make the lessons go faster.

tips.li: Each blackboard in the room speeds up learning at the desks, up to three of them.
A child learns only while an adult who can teach is awake. Give the teacher time in their schedule.
A toy box nearby gives the children something to do between lessons.

ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.label: playroom
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.description: Three toy boxes along the back wall, a game table with two stools, a light and a soft floor.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.purpose: Children need play as much as lessons. A room of their own keeps them busy and out of the workshops.

tips.li: Children play with toy boxes to fill their recreation. Several boxes mean they don't wait for each other.
Put the playroom between the bedrooms and the schoolroom, away from the gate where raids come in.
A soft, clean floor and a light make the room nicer for the children and the adults who watch them.

ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.label: mechanitor's bay
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.description: A mech gestator against the back wall, two mech rechargers on the side walls, a shelf for steel and a light.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.purpose: Where a mechanitor builds mechanoids and where they come back to recharge, out of the weather.

tips.li: Rechargers fill up with toxic wastepacks. Keep haulers on them, or the pollution builds up nearby.
Gestators and rechargers draw power all the time. Plan the generators before the bay.
Lightweight mechs use mech rechargers; bigger mechs need the larger kind.

ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.label: gene lab
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.description: A gene assembler against the back wall, two gene banks beside it, a gene processor and a light.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.purpose: Genes from genepacks, combined into xenogerms: the colony's own xenotypes, made here.

tips.li: Gene banks and gene processors only count when they're near the assembler and in the same room.
Each gene processor raises the complexity a xenogerm can have. Add more as the library grows.
Genepacks deteriorate outside a powered gene bank. Store them there as soon as they arrive.

ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.label: containment cell
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.description: A holding platform in the middle of a small, closed room, with shard inhibitors in the back corners.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.purpose: Somewhere to keep a captured entity to study it, as far from the colonists as the base allows.

tips.li: Containment strength comes from strong walls, a small room and inhibitors. Build the walls of stone or better.
One door, and an airlock of two doors if the entity is dangerous. An escape usually starts at the door.
Shard inhibitors raise containment for every platform within five cells, even through walls.
Electric inhibitors are stronger but have to face the platform. Place them by hand once the cell is built.
